purpose: find and fix vulnerabilities and unsafe configuration in container images and their runtime settings before they run in production
entry_criteria: Image is built from a pinned base image and a Dockerfile in the repository
Registry and scanner access are available
Runtime policy (user, capabilities, network) is defined
procedure: Build the image from a clean checkout and record its digest; scan the digest, not a tag.
Scan OS packages and application dependencies for known vulnerabilities; record advisory ids and fixed versions.
Check the image configuration: non-root user, no embedded secrets, minimal base, read-only filesystem where possible, no unnecessary capabilities.
Fix by updating the base image or packages, or by removing the component; document any accepted finding with owner and expiry.
Rebuild, rescan the new digest and compare findings with the previous scan.
Sign or record the approved digest so deployment can verify it matches.
deliverables: image scan report for the digest
acceptance_criteria: The scanned digest equals the digest that will be deployed
No unresolved critical or high finding without an approved exception
Image runs as a non-root user with no embedded secrets
Every exception has owner and expiry
validation_method: Security owner and system owner disposition of remaining findings.

validation.command: trivy image --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --exit-code 1 registry.example.com/app@sha256:<digest>   # example; use the project's scanner
validation.expect: exit 0, or only findings listed in the exception register
a non-root user, not empty and not root

failure_modes.mode: Scanned a tag that later moved
failure_modes.detection: Scan digest differs from deployed digest
failure_modes.response: Rescan the deployed digest; BLOCKED until it matches

failure_modes.mode: Secret baked into an image layer
failure_modes.detection: Scanner or history inspection finds a credential
failure_modes.response: Rotate the secret, rebuild without it, never rely on deleting a later layer

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: The scan of a service image reports a critical OpenSSL issue in the base layer. The base image is bumped to the patched release, the digest changes, the rescan is clean, and the container runs as user 10001.
